We have template ID 3421 with retro_smarts_template (retrosynthetic direction) and canonical forward template. The retro_smarts_template is:

[#7:6]=[C:7]-[N;H0;D3;+0:8](-[C;D1;H3:9])-[S;H0;D2;+0:1]-[N;H0;D3;+0:4](-[C;D1;H3:5])-[C:3]=[#7:2]>>Cl-[S;H0;D2;+0:1]-Cl.[#7:2]=[C:3]-[NH;D2;+0:4]-[C;D1;H3:5].[#7:6]=[C:7]-[NH;D2;+0:8]-[C;D1;H3:9]

So this is a disconnection of a central S (sulfur) with two leaving groups Cl? Actually forward reaction: Cl-S-Cl + imine fragments -> product. The retrosynthetic direction splits product into three fragments: Cl-S-Cl (i.e., SCl2?), plus two fragments: imine fragments.

Our target molecule is COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to apply this template to the target to get precursors. The template seems to involve a S atom with two substituents (Cl) and a C=N double bond attached to S? Actually product side: [#7:6]=[C:7]-[N...]-[S...]-[N...]-[C:3]=[#7:2] . So product contains a S atom attached to two N atoms each part of imine? The target molecule does not contain sulfur. So template likely not applicable. The apply_template returned empty list earlier. So maybe there is another template ID? The earlier input from make_6_lvl2-template_search-1 gave mapped_rxn and template_id 3421. That suggests that template is the one that reproduces the reaction (Sn2) for the target? But the template seems unrelated. Possibly the mapping is wrong.

We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of task make_6_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule. The template ID is 3421, we need to apply it to the target molecule and list precursors. Since apply_template gave empty, maybe there are no precursors. But we should verify using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to see if matches.
